title: Financial Assistance to Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)
description: This scheme by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala, provides financial assistance to differently-abled school dropouts to help them pursue SSLC, +1, and +2 equivalent courses through the State Literacy Mission.
requirements: Income Certificate or Copy of Ration Card (if applicable)
eligibility: Resident of Kerala with 40% or more disability. Applicable to both APL and BPL category students pursuing 10th, 11th, or 12th equivalent courses.
financial_requirements: Available to students from both APL and BPL categories.
application_process: Visit nearest Anganwadi Centre or District Social Justice Office to get the form (also available online).
Fill out the application completely.
Submit to DSJOs or Anganwadi Centre.

title: Financial Assistance to Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)
description: A welfare scheme by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala, aimed at providing financial aid to differently-abled students who have dropped out but wish to pursue SSLC, +1, and +2 equivalent courses through the State Literacy Mission.
requirements: Disability Certificate (40% or more disability is mandatory)
Income Certificate or Copy of Ration Card (if applicable)
eligibility: Differently-abled students (40% or more disability) who are residents of Kerala and belong to either APL or BPL category. Must be pursuing 10th, 11th, or 12th equivalent courses through the State Literacy Mission.
financial_requirements: Open to both Above Poverty Line (APL) and Below Poverty Line (BPL) students.
application_process: Collect the application form from nearest Anganwadi Centre or District Social Justice Office, or download from the Social Justice Department website.
Fill the form completely and attach all required documents.
Submit the form to the District Social Justice Officer (DSJO) or the concerned Anganwadi Centre.

title: ICMR - Post Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF)
description: The ICMR Post Doctoral Fellowship Scheme provides high-quality research opportunities for fresh PhD/MD/MS holders in cutting-edge areas such as basic science, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and reproductive health. Fifty fellowships are offered each year to work at ICMR Institutes/Centers equipped with state-of-the-art R&D facilities.
requirements: Attested copy of School Leaving/High School Certificate (for date of birth)
Attested copies of Mark Sheets/Grade Cards & Degrees
Attested copy of Caste Certificate (if applicable)
Pre-prints or Letter(s) of Acceptance for papers
Testimonials from two referees (including Ph.D. Guide)
Plagiarism Check Report verified by ICMR-RIO
eligibility: Indian nationals with a Ph.D./MD/MS degree awarded within 3 years (or provisional degree), applying for research related to their Ph.D./MD/MS. Maximum age limit is 32 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates, and further 3 years for deserving candidates based on past work, awards, or publications.
financial_requirements: Not Applicable

benefits.Monthly Fellowship: ₹65,000 + HRA as per GoI rules + NPA (if applicable)
benefits.Contingency Grant: ₹3,00,000 per annum (25% can be used for national travel)
Other Benefits: Accommodation may be provided (HRA not applicable if availed)
Medical benefits and leave as per ICMR norms

tenure: 2 years, extendable by 1 year based on performance and recommendation
application_process: Download the application form from the official ICMR website.
Fill the form completely and write NA/Nil where applicable.
Attach all required documents and self-attested copies.
Send the completed application to: Director General, ICMR Headquarters, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029. Attention: Sh. Kishor Toppo, Technical Officer-C.
Email: toppok.hq@icmr.gov.in, mpdicmr@gmail.com
Ensure application is routed through the sponsoring ICMR Institute/Center.
selection_process: Shortlisted candidates are interviewed by a Selection Committee at ICMR Hqrs., New Delhi. Evaluation is based on publications, citations, and impact factors. Candidates abroad may be considered in absentia if eligible.

title: ICMR - Post Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF)
description: The ICMR Post Doctoral Fellowship Scheme (ICMR-PDF) supports high-quality research for fresh Ph.D./MD/MS holders in fields such as basic science, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and reproductive health. Fifty fellowships are granted annually to work in ICMR Institutes/Centers with state-of-the-art R&D facilities.
requirements: Attested copy of School Leaving/ High School Certificate (for date of birth)
Attested copies of Mark Sheets/Grade Cards & Degrees
Attested copy of the Caste certificate (if applicable)
Attested copies of Letter(s) of Acceptance for papers accepted & pre-prints
Testimonials from two Referees (one should be Ph.D. Guide)
Plagiarism Check Report verified by ICMR-RIO
eligibility: Open to Indian nationals with a Ph.D./MD/MS awarded within 3 years (or provisional degree) as on the application deadline. Research work must be a continuation of previous academic work. Age limit is 32 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH/women and up to 3 more years for exceptional candidates.
financial_requirements: Not Applicable

benefits.fellowship_amount: ₹65,000 per month + HRA as per GoI rules + NPA (if applicable)
benefits.contingency_grant: ₹3,00,000 per annum (25% allowed for domestic travel)
other_benefits: Medical benefits as per ICMR norms
Accommodation may be provided (no HRA in such case)
Leave benefits as per JRF/Research Associate rules

tenure: 2 years, extendable by 1 year on recommendation and outstanding performance
application_process: Download and fill the application form from ICMR website
Complete all fields; use NA/Nil where applicable
Attach required self-attested documents
Send the completed form to: Director General, ICMR Headquarters, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029. Attention: Sh. Kishor Toppo
Email: toppok.hq@icmr.gov.in, mpdicmr@gmail.com
Applications must be routed through the sponsoring ICMR Institutes/Centers
selection_process: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by a selection committee at ICMR HQ, New Delhi. Evaluation is based on publications, impact factor, and citations. Candidates abroad may be considered in absentia if found eligible.
category: Fellowship, Research, Post Doctoral

title: Snehasanthwanam
description: The 'Snehasanthwanam' scheme, launched by the Government of Kerala under the Kerala Social Security Mission, provides financial assistance to Endosulfan victims and educational support to their children. It also offers caregiver support under the Aswasakiranam scheme.
requirements: Medical proof of Endosulfan victim status
Details of caregiver (if applying for caregiver benefit)
Proof of education for children (if applying for educational assistance)
Aadhaar card and bank account details
eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Kerala and an Endosulfan victim, or a caregiver of a fully bedridden/mentally retarded Endosulfan victim. Children of Endosulfan-affected families are eligible for educational assistance.
financial_requirements: Not Applicable

financial_assistance: ₹2200 per month to bedridden Endosulfan victims
₹1700 per month for victims also receiving ₹300 disability pension
₹1200 per month to other Endosulfan victims as per District Collector list

application_process: Submit application to Kerala Social Security Mission through District offices or local authorities
Attach necessary supporting documents such as medical reports, educational certificates, and identity proof
Ensure name is listed with the District Collector for eligibility
selection_process: Verification of documents and beneficiary listing through the District Collector’s office.
category: Financial Assistance, Educational Support, Disability, Victim Relief
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala

title: Additional Scholarship for OBC Students of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Higher Studies in India
description: The scheme provides additional financial assistance to OBC students from the non-creamy layer of Andaman and Nicobar Islands to pursue higher education anywhere in India after Secondary education, except Class XI & XII.
requirements: Caste Certificate (signed by authorized revenue officer, not below Tehsildar)
Marks statement for renewal (signed by institution)
eligibility: Students must belong to the non-creamy layer of OBC community as notified by the Andaman and Nicobar Administration, must be domiciled in Andaman & Nicobar Islands, and should be pursuing recognized higher education after passing Class X or XII. Only two children per family are eligible (with exception for multiple births).
financial_requirements: Non-creamy layer OBC category

benefits.scholarship_amount: ₹1000 per month for 10 months per academic session
benefits.duration: Till completion of the course, subject to good conduct and attendance
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct transfer to Aadhaar-linked bank account

tenure: Yearly renewable, based on course progression
application_process: Register at National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in/)
Obtain Student Registration ID
Login and fill out the Fresh Application
Submit required documents and complete final submission
Track registration number for future reference
last_dates: Applications are invited annually around May-June
selection_process: Verification of eligibility and documents. Renewal subject to promotion to the next academic year and submission of required proof.
exclusions: Students repeating the same level of course in another subject
Pursuing a second professional course after completing one
Courses already funded by Central/State/UT Government (e.g., Defence Academies, Aircraft Maintenance, Distance Education)
Practicing students during Postgraduate Medical courses
category: Scholarship, OBC, Higher Education, Student Welfare
ministry: Department of Social Welfare, Andaman and Nicobar Administration

title: Dr. Ambedkar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for the Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
description: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Economically Backward Class (EBC) students for pursuing post-matric or post-secondary education in India. It is awarded by the respective State/UT Governments to students permanently settled in their region.
requirements: Passport-size photograph with signature (for fresh application)
Original income certificate from a revenue officer not below Tehsildar
Acknowledgement receipt of previous year's scholarship (for renewal)
Reader charges certificate (if applicable, for blind students)
Institution verification (study tours/thesis charges if applicable)
eligibility: Open to Indian nationals belonging to General Category (excluding SC/ST/OBC) who belong to the EBC community, with family income not exceeding ₹1,00,000 per annum. Must be pursuing recognized post-matric or post-secondary education in India. Only two boys per family are eligible; this does not apply to girls.
financial_requirements: Annual parental/guardian income should not exceed ₹1,00,000

benefits.duration: Tenable from the stage at which it is given to the completion of the course, subject to good conduct and attendance
benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct bank transfer (with shift to Smart Cards encouraged)

tenure: Yearly renewable, based on promotion to the next academic year
application_process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in/)
Obtain Application ID and password
Login to portal and reset password
Access dashboard and fill in Application Form
Upload required documents and submit
Track status via Application ID
last_dates: Applications are typically accepted once every academic session. Refer to NSP for the latest timeline.
selection_process: Verification of eligibility and document completeness. Renewal contingent on class promotion and academic performance.
exclusions: Students studying the same level again in a different subject (e.g., B.Com after B.A.)
Students completing one professional course and enrolling in another
Courses already receiving full funding (e.g., CPL, Defence Academies, etc.)
Students practicing medicine during PG courses
Students enrolled in XI/XII of Higher Secondary unless 10th was treated as Matric equivalent
Students already receiving another scholarship (must choose one)
category: Scholarship, Economically Backward Class, Higher Education, Student Welfare
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Dr. Ambedkar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
description: This scheme provides financial support to General Category students (excluding SC/ST/OBC) belonging to the Economically Backward Class (EBC), for pursuing post-matric or post-secondary education in India. It covers maintenance, fees, study tours, and other academic expenses.
requirements: Application form (fresh or renewal as prescribed by State/UT)
Passport-size photograph with signature (for fresh application)
Attested copies of exam certificates (latest passed)
Original income certificate issued by Revenue Officer (Tehsildar or above)
eligibility: Open to General Category students (excluding SC/ST/OBC) who belong to the EBC category. Must be pursuing recognized post-matric/post-secondary courses in India. Family income should not exceed ₹1,00,000 per annum. Maximum of two boys per family (no restriction for girls).
financial_requirements: Annual parental income not exceeding ₹1,00,000

scholarship_amount.note: Scholars receiving free boarding/lodging will get 1/3rd of hosteller rate.

fees_covered: Games, Union, and other compulsory fees

study_tour_charges.conditions: Only for professional/technical courses certified as essential by the institution

thesis_typing_printing.conditions: On recommendation of Head of Institution

benefits: Reimbursement of non-refundable institutional fees
₹900 per annum for prescribed textbooks

benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct transfer to bank/post office accounts (Smart Card transition underway)

tenure: Till completion of the course, renewable yearly based on promotion to the next academic year
application_process: Visit National Scholarship Portal: https://scholarships.gov.in
Click on 'New Registration' and complete signup
Receive Application ID via SMS
Login and reset password
Fill application form and upload required documents
Submit application (final or draft)
last_dates: Check NSP portal each academic session for updated timeline
selection_process: Verification of eligibility, income, and academic documents. Renewal depends on successful promotion to the next class.
exclusions: Students holding other scholarships (must choose one)
Pursuing CPL or aviation-linked courses
Repeating same level education in a different subject (e.g., BA after BSc)
Doing same level again in another stream (e.g., LLB after B.Ed)
Students of Class XI & XII unless Class X is treated as Matric equivalent
Students undergoing training at government coaching centers
category: Scholarship, Economically Backward Class, Higher Education, Student Welfare
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Financial Assistance under Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
description: The Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme provides ex-gratia financial assistance to the legal heir of a working journalist in case of death or to the journalist in case of permanent incapacitation. Managed by the Information & Public Relations Department, Government of Odisha, this scheme aims to support the journalist community during unforeseen hardships.
requirements: Copy of Accreditation Card (for accredited journalists)
eligibility: The applicant must be a working journalist in Odisha associated with a media house registered with the Information & Public Relations (I&PR) Department. In the case of death or incapacitation, the applicant must be a legal heir of the journalist or the journalist themselves (for incapacitation cases).
financial_requirements: None specified

benefits.mode_of_payment: Direct bank transfer to the applicant's account

application_process: Visit the official portal: https://owjws.odisha.gov.in/
Click on 'Apply for Financial Assistance' at the bottom of the page
Select and fill the form: 'Application for Financial Assistance in case of death of a working journalist'
Submit all mandatory information and upload required documents
Receive an application number and SMS confirmation
Log in using registered mobile number and OTP
Track application status on the portal
last_dates: Applications accepted year-round upon incident occurrence
selection_process: Verification of eligibility, employment status, and submitted documents by the Information & Public Relations Department
category: Welfare, Journalist, Financial Assistance, Odisha
ministry: Information & Public Relations Department, Government of Odisha

title: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
description: A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education, for single girl children pursuing full-time Ph.D. programs in recognized Indian universities, colleges, or institutes. The scheme promotes higher education among single girl children and supports their research work in various disciplines.
requirements: Scanned passport-size photograph and signature (up to 1MB, jpg format)
Proof of being a single girl child on ₹100 stamp paper affidavit, attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar
Auto-generated application form signed by HoD/Registrar
eligibility: (i) Must be a single girl child (only daughter, no siblings) pursuing a full-time Ph.D. in a recognized institution. (ii) Girl scholars up to 40 years (general) and 45 years (SC/ST/OBC/PWD) on the last application date are eligible. (iii) Admission in part-time or distance mode Ph.D. programs is not eligible.
financial_requirements: None specified

benefits.hra: As per Government of India norms, depending on hostel accommodation availability and actual rent receipts
benefits.medical_assistance: No fixed amount, access to institution facilities

leave.earned_leave: 30 days per year plus public holidays
leave.maternity_leave: As per Govt. of India norms (once during fellowship)
leave.intermittent_breaks: Max 1 year in total, up to 3 times (without fellowship)
leave.academic_leave: Up to 1 year without fellowship for academic work

tenure: Maximum 5 years or till submission of Ph.D. thesis, whichever is earlier
application_process: Visit the portal: https://frg.ugc.ac.in/
Click on 'New User' to register for the scheme
Fill in the registration form and submit scanned photo/signature
Login using credentials emailed to you, change password on first login
Fill profile, complete eligibility section, and submit affidavit for single girl child
Enter PG and Ph.D. details, upload research documents
Submit declaration and finalize application
Download the auto-generated form, get it signed by HoD/Registrar and upload
last_dates: Application invited once a year (check UGC website for specific dates)
selection_process: Selection based on eligibility verification and completeness of submitted documents
exclusions: Girls who have one or more brothers (even if she is the only girl)
Part-time/distance/open learning Ph.D. candidates
Applications with incomplete documentation or invalid affidavits
category: Fellowship, Higher Education, Ph.D., Girl Child

title: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
description: An initiative by the Government of Assam to organize educational visits for students from High School to College level to the Assam Legislative Assembly. The program aims to provide practical exposure to the workings of the legislative process and to instill civic knowledge among students.
requirements: List of participating students submitted to the Assembly Secretariat for passes
One-page experience and feedback write-up per student to be submitted within a week
eligibility: 1. Students from High Schools, Higher Secondary Schools, and Colleges in Assam. 2. Preference given to students from Political Science, Economics, and Social Sciences streams. 3. Good academic performers and students involved in debates, mock parliaments, and extracurricular activities. 4. Batch size should not exceed 50. 5. Participation must be voluntary.
financial_requirements: None

benefits.practical_exposure: Students witness real-time legislative sessions, debates, and bill discussions.
benefits.interaction: Opportunities to interact with the Hon’ble Speaker, Chief Minister, Ministers, MLAs, and officials.
benefits.governance_education: Better understanding of how the State Legislative Assembly and democratic processes work.

tenure: Visit duration is based on Assembly session schedules; each visit is one-time but organized periodically for batches.
application_process: Educational institutions and students are selected in consultation with DCs/Inspectors of Schools.
Approved invitations are sent to institutions by the Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
Recommendations from government dignitaries (CM, MLAs, MPs, etc.) are considered.
Heads of institutions inform students and assign accompanying male and female teachers.
ASTC provides transportation within Guwahati for the visit.
last_dates: No fixed application date; coordinated based on Assembly session schedules and government invitations.
selection_process: Selections are made by headmasters/principals based on academic and extracurricular criteria, following coordination with DCs/Inspectors of Schools.
exclusions: Institutions or students outside Assam
Non-willing students
Students from unrelated academic streams may have lower priority
category: Educational Visit, Civic Education, Student Development

title: Scheme of Assistance for the Prevention of Alcoholism & Substance (Drugs) Abuse and for Social Defence Services
description: A Central Sector Scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment aimed at preventing substance abuse and supporting social defence initiatives by providing financial assistance to eligible organizations for services like awareness, de-addiction, rehabilitation, training, and integrated social welfare projects.
requirements: Building plan, site layout, and estimated cost (for construction-related projects)
Proof of site ownership (for construction projects)
Detailed project proposal including objectives, target group, geographic coverage, and expected outcomes
Break-up of recurring and non-recurring costs
Details of managing body and previous experience
eligibility: Registered societies, charitable companies, public trusts, universities, research institutes, and statutory bodies such as PRIs, municipal corporations, and Red Cross branches. Organizations must have at least 2 years' experience or proven capacity to run the proposed project.
financial_requirements: Organizations must contribute at least 10% of the project cost unless operating in underserved areas where the government may fund 100%.

benefits.financial_assistance: Up to 90% of approved project cost, 100% in special cases.
admissible_items: Building construction or rent (excluding staff quarters)

tenure: Ongoing scheme with annual funding; bond required for 5 years of continued operation.
application_process: Step 1: Submit application online with required documents
Step 2: Inspection and assessment by designated agency
Step 3: 70% of grant released as first installment upon approval
Step 4: Remaining 30% released upon fulfillment of documentation and expenditure reports
Step 5: Execute a 5-year continuity bond prior to fund disbursement
last_dates: Applications accepted year-round; funding depends on approval and budget allocation.
selection_process: Based on proposal merit, target group impact, geographical need, previous experience, and compliance with documentation. Inspection and evaluation by designated agency.
exclusions: For-profit organizations
Unregistered or informal bodies
Projects not aligning with social defence objectives
Projects without acquired building land (for construction grants)
category: Health, De-addiction, Social Welfare, NGO Support
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

title: Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme to Dependents of Crime Victims
description: A welfare scheme launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala, offering financial assistance to crime victims or their dependents to support self-employment opportunities and restore livelihood.
requirements: Copy of Ration Card (including holder and family members pages)
Project proposal for the proposed business
Income Certificate (annual income must be below ₹1,00,000)
Copy of FIR related to the crime
Copy of Bank Passbook with account details
eligibility: The applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala and either be the person seriously injured in a crime or a dependent (wife/husband/unmarried son/daughter) of the crime victim. Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000. Application must be submitted within 5 years from the date of the crime.
financial_requirements: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
application_process: Step 1: Visit the SUNEETHI - Online Service Application Portal
Step 2: Click on 'One time Registration' and provide personal details
Step 3: Verify mobile number with OTP
Step 4: Complete profile registration with necessary information
Step 5: Login using mobile number and password
Step 6: Update full profile including bank and ID details
Step 7: Select scheme and click 'Apply Now'
Step 8: Fill in application form and submit
last_dates: Must apply within 5 years from the date of the crime
selection_process: Eligible applicants are selected based on verification of documents and approval by the Department of Social Justice, Kerala. Selected beneficiaries must sign an agreement on ₹200 stamp paper.
exclusions: Applicants with annual income above ₹1,00,000
Applications submitted after 5 years from the date of crime
Applicants not residing in Kerala
category: Social Welfare, Victim Compensation, Livelihood Support
ministry: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala

title: Nari Niketans
description: A 100% state-sponsored welfare scheme launched in 1976 by the Social Welfare Department of Jammu and Kashmir to provide care, shelter, education, and rehabilitation support for deserted, destitute women and widows with no means of livelihood.
requirements: Residential Certificate / Domicile Certificate of Jammu & Kashmir
Death Certificate of the Husband (if applicable)
Bank Account Details (Self or Guardian): Name, Branch, Address, IFSC
Proof of Age of the Child (Birth Certificate) for accompanying children
Any additional documents as required by the District Social Welfare Office
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident (domicile) of Jammu & Kashmir, female, and either deserted, destitute, or a widow with no means of livelihood. Children of the applicant may be admitted, but male children above 8 years of age will be transferred to Bal Ashrams.
financial_requirements: No income source; economically dependent

benefits.shelter: Free stay in government-run Nari Niketans until rehabilitation/marriage/employment
benefits.care_and_protection: Complete care, food, clothing, and medical support
benefits.child_support: Children accompanying mothers are admitted with restrictions

tenure: Till the beneficiary is rehabilitated, married, or employed
application_process: Step 1: Visit the District Social Welfare Office (DSWO)
Step 2: Collect and fill the application form with required details and documents
Step 3: Paste passport-size photo and attach self-attested documents
Step 4: Submit to DSWO and collect the acknowledgment receipt
post_application: Step 1: DSWO forwards applications to the District Level Sanctioning Committee
Step 2: Final admission decision is made by the Superintendent with DSWO and Deputy Director approval
check_status: Contact the respective District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO)
last_dates: No specific deadline; rolling application based on need and availability
selection_process: District authorities review application and make decisions based on verification and need. Admissions are approved by the District Sanctioning Committee.
exclusions: Non-residents of Jammu & Kashmir
Males
Women with existing stable income or livelihood
category: Shelter, Women Welfare, Rehabilitation
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Jammu and Kashmir

title: Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
description: This scheme, launched by the Labour Department of Chhattisgarh on 28 April 2012, provides financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for the medical treatment of serious illnesses like kidney disease, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS, and paralysis for registered unorganized workers.
requirements: Medical certificate with disease details issued by authorized health official (Vikas Khand Adhikari / Surgeon / CMO / Health Officer)
Approximate treatment expense details from the Medical Officer
eligibility: Registered unorganized worker with the State Board for at least 90 days, aged between 18 and 60 years, and covered under Section 10 of the unorganized workers' welfare act.
financial_requirements: None specified, but must be unorganized worker and not receiving similar benefits under any other government scheme.

benefits.medical_assistance: Up to ₹50,000 for treatment of serious illnesses (actual expense reimbursed if below ₹50,000)

tenure: One-time benefit per illness per worker
application_process: Visit the official Chhattisgarh Labour Department portal
For new applicants: Navigate to 'Asangathit Shramik Panjikaran' under 'Asangathit Marmakaar Mandal' group and fill the registration form
For already registered applicants: Navigate to 'Yojana' section, select the relevant scheme, provide registration number, and fill in application details
Upload documents and submit the application
post_application: Verification by officials and assessment of medical documents
Approval and fund disbursement based on actual treatment cost or ₹50,000 limit
check_status: Track through Chhattisgarh Labour Department portal or visit the local Labour Office
last_dates: Rolling basis; can apply after diagnosis/treatment requirement
selection_process: Application review and verification by designated medical and labour authorities. Funds released upon validation.
exclusions: Applicants availing benefits from other government schemes for the same treatment
Applicants not registered under the Board or those registered for less than 90 days
category: Health, Financial Assistance, Labour Welfare

title: Asangathit Karmakar Gambhir Bimari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
description: A financial assistance scheme launched by the Labour Department of Chhattisgarh on 28 April 2012 for unorganized workers suffering from serious illnesses including kidney issues, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS, and paralysis.

benefits.medical_assistance: Up to ₹50,000 for treatment of eligible serious illnesses; if actual cost is less, only that amount is reimbursed

eligibility.registration: Must be registered with the State Board for at least 90 days
eligibility.status: Registered as an unorganized worker under Section 10 of the Act

exclusions: Applicants receiving similar benefits from other government schemes
documents_required: Disease certificate by Vikas Khand Adhikari / Surgeon / Chief Medical Officer / Health Officer
Approximate treatment cost certified by related Medical Officer

new_applicant: Visit the Chhattisgarh Labour Department official website
Click on 'Apply' under 'Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board'
Check eligibility and fill the registration form
existing_applicant: Visit the Chhattisgarh Labour Department official website
Click on 'Apply' under 'Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board'
Enter district name and registration number
Select scheme and fill in the required details

steps: Application review by authorities
Verification of medical and registration documents
Approval and disbursement of medical assistance to the applicant

how_to_check_status: Track via Chhattisgarh Labour Department portal or contact local labour office

title: Airavata Scheme
description: The Airavata Scheme is a self-employment initiative by the Government of Karnataka in collaboration with cab aggregators like OLA and Uber. It aims to empower unemployed SC/ST youth by providing subsidies and financial assistance to help them purchase and operate taxis.

benefits.coverage: 50% subsidy on the cost of the vehicle
benefits.additional_support: Government training and onboarding with Ola/Uber

eligibility.residency: Must be a resident of Karnataka
eligibility.license: Must hold a valid driving license and cab badge
eligibility.income: Family income should not exceed ₹5,00,000 per annum
eligibility.prior_benefits: Not eligible if applicant or family member has availed government subsidy exceeding ₹1,00,000 earlier
eligibility.selection_criteria: Based on merit - Age, Education, Driving Experience, and Badge

exclusions: Applicant or family member who has availed more than ₹1,00,000 subsidy earlier
Applicant not willing to drive for Ola/Uber or operate tourist taxi in eligible districts
Applicant not willing to undergo mandatory training by Ola/Uber

steps: Visit the official Airavata Scheme portal
Go to the 'Karnataka Airavata Scheme Registration Form'
Sign in or register on the platform
Fill in the application form with accurate personal and professional details
Upload required documents
Submit the completed application online
Application is reviewed by the department
Shortlisted candidates are selected based on merit
Training is provided by Ola/Uber
Vehicle subsidy is granted and vehicle is allocated for use

how_to_check_status: Log in to the official Airavata scheme portal using credentials and track application status under 'My Applications'

scheme_details.implementing_agency: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Development Corporation, Government of Karnataka

title: Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme Karnataka
description: The Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme is a financial assistance program by the Government of Karnataka aimed at empowering women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry. The scheme supports SHGs with subsidies and loans to promote business activities, skill development, and economic independence.

benefits.representation: 33% for women artisans, 5% for physically challenged individuals

eligibility.government_benefits_exclusion: Not eligible if already received benefits from other schemes (except training programs)
eligibility.employment_exclusion: Applicant's family should not be employed in government/semi-government organizations

Copy of the Updated Fishing License Certificate
Copy of the Updated Fishing Net Licence
Copy of Biometric Card/Temporary ID Card
Inspection Report of Registered Fishing Vessel/ OBM/ Net in Original
Copy of the Bank Passbook Along With the Mandate Form
Statement of Contribution for Fishermen Corpus Fund by Applicant
Post-mortem Report/ Missing Report/ Death Certificate
Copy of Loss Assessment Report From Authorized Marine Surveyor

Up to ₹10,00,000 for 6 to 8-cylinder fishing vessel

Rampon Nets: up to ₹1,00,000
Trawl Net: up to ₹50,000
Purseine Net: up to ₹5,00,000

Fill in the form with mandatory details, paste photo, attach documents
Submit form at the Department of Fisheries office or designated sub-offices
Claims must be submitted within one week of the incident

title: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
description: INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship offers post-doctoral opportunities to young achievers with Ph.D. qualifications (aged 27–32) in science, engineering, medicine, agriculture, veterinary sciences, and pharmacy. It supports 100 fellows annually with financial assistance and a research grant for up to 5 years, encouraging independent research and strengthening India's scientific manpower.
requirements: Class X Mark sheet or Certificate (for proof of Date of Birth)
Proof of Academic Qualifications from Class 12 onward (Degrees, Certificates, Mark Sheets)
First Rank Certificate (if not an INSPIRE Scholar)
Undertakings from Fellow and Host Institute (upon selection)
Budget break-up and Host Institute bank details
eligibility: Indian citizens and PIOs with a Ph.D. in science, mathematics, engineering, pharmacy, medicine, or agriculture-related subjects
Minimum 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in all academic levels from Class 12 onwards
Age limit as of Jan 1 of the application year: General – 32 years, SC/ST/Women – 37 years, Divyangjan – 42 years
Publications in reputed journals showcasing research potential

Candidates employed in India must resign from existing positions before taking up the fellowship
desirable: 1st rank holders in UG/PG university exams
exclusions: Cannot hold two fellowships simultaneously during the tenure

Final decision made by DST
transfer_guidelines: Notify DST in case of host institution change or absorption

completion_guidelines: Upload Final Technical Report, Equipment List, Performance Report, Statement of Expenditure, Utilization Certificates
Return unspent funds via Bharatkosh portal to the Consolidated Fund of India

requirements: Academic transcripts for all obtained degrees
eligibility: Must be an Indian citizen
Master’s degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university
Must qualify the Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET)
Should not exceed 28 years of age for General/EWS category
Age relaxation up to 33 years for SC/ST/PH category
Must be willing to pursue full-time doctoral research at a recognized university or research institute in India

Step 4: Attend interview if shortlisted, based on research proposal and domain knowledge
Step 5: Check final selection list on the DBT website

selection_process: Qualify BET exam
Online application submission with documents
Shortlisting and interview
Final selection based on interview performance
other_details.administered_by: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India
other_details.host: Recognized Indian universities and research institutions

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Sikkim
description: The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) in Sikkim provides financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension to elderly citizens aged 60 years and above from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. The scheme is administered by the Department of Women & Child Welfare, Government of Sikkim.
requirements: Attested photocopy of Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification
Birth Certificate / Electoral photo ID / Any valid age proof document
Attested photocopy of first page and latest transaction of Bank/Post Office passbook
eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Sikkim
Must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family
Must be aged 60 years or above
Should not have any source of income
Should not be receiving pension/salary/family pension from Central or other State Governments
Must have a bank account under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
exclusions: Persons receiving pension from Central/State Governments or Statutory Bodies
Only one member from a household (if both spouses are eligible) is permitted
Non-submission of Life Certificate annually results in discontinuation
financial_requirements: Must belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) family
benefits: ₹1500/month for age 60–69 years
₹2000/month for age 70+ years
₹2500/month for age 80+ years
Pension is given as long as the beneficiary is alive
application_process: Step 1: Approach the concerned Gram Panchayat / Municipality / Municipal Corporation office to collect the application form
Step 2: Fill out the form and attach all self-attested required documents
Step 3: Submit the form to the designated authority
Step 4: The application is scrutinized by the Selection Committee and approved by the Secretary
Step 5: Pension is granted and order is shared with district officials and the applicant
Step 6: Pension is transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
Step 7: Submit a Life Certificate every November to continue receiving pension

other_details.duration: Lifetime, as long as the beneficiary is alive and eligible
other_details.administered_by: Department of Women & Child Welfare, Government of Sikkim
other_details.note_1: Only one eligible person from the same household can avail the pension
other_details.note_2: In the event of the pensioner’s death, pension may be transferred to spouse (if eligible and age 60+)

category: Old Age, Pension, Direct Benefit Transfer, Below Poverty Line

title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana
description: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is an initiative by the Government of Gujarat to promote women's entrepreneurship by providing interest-free loans of up to ₹1 lakh without collateral, along with training and skill development programs to empower women financially.
requirements: Any government-issued ID proof (Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card)
Government-issued address proof (Voter ID, Driving License, Passport)
Certificate of having passed at least 8th standard
Detailed business plan (type of business, investment, expected revenue)
Bank account details for loan disbursement
eligibility: Must be a woman
Permanent resident of Gujarat
Minimum age: 18 years
Passed at least 8th standard
Valid Aadhaar card
exclusions: Government employees are not eligible
Beneficiaries of other similar schemes for this purpose are excluded
financial_requirements: No income limit
benefits: Interest-free loan up to ₹1 lakh for starting or expanding business
No collateral required
Subsidy of 6% per annum for timely repayment
No processing fee
Repayment period up to 5 years
Training and skill development support
Encourages employment generation and financial independence
application_process: Step 1: Visit the official website of the scheme or go to the nearest GWEDC office
Step 2: Download the application form or collect it physically
Step 3: Fill the application form with required personal and business details
Step 4: Attach all necessary documents
Step 5: Submit the completed application form through the designated channel

other_details.training: Entrepreneurship and business skill development included

category: Mahila, Mukhyamantri, Utkarsh Yojana, Entrepreneurship, Loan, Women Empowerment

title: ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF)
description: The ASEAN-India Research Training Fellowship (AI-RTF) is an initiative by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India, to support young researchers from ASEAN countries in pursuing short-term research at Indian R&D institutions across various fields of science, technology, and innovation.
requirements: Copy of relevant pages of valid passport
Endorsement letter from present employer (in prescribed format)
Acceptance letter from Indian scientist/institution (in prescribed format)
eligibility: Must be a citizen of an ASEAN member country (Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam)
Possess at least a Master’s Degree in Natural Sciences, Technology, Engineering, Medicine, or allied disciplines
Affiliated with an R&D or academic institution in home ASEAN country
Endorsed by the head of the institution confirming leave and return post-fellowship
Fluency in English
Maximum age limit: 45 years at the time of application submission
desirable: Prior contact and consent from an Indian host institution/scientist
exclusions: Indian nationals are not eligible
Applicants who have availed any Indian fellowship in the last 3 years are not eligible
financial_requirements: No income-related conditions
benefits: Monthly fellowship of INR 60,000
Round-trip economy airfare from home country to India
One-time contingency grant of INR 40,000 for research and local travel
Institutional overhead charges of INR 2,500/month
Visa fees and overseas medical insurance covered
Support in securing accommodation via the host institution
application_process: Step 1: Visit www.aistic.gov.in and register on the ASEAN portal
Step 2: Log in and complete the profile section
Step 3: Fill out the proposal form with project details
Step 4: Upload all required documents in a single PDF (max 10MB)
Step 5: Submit the application online (no hard copies required)

other_details.mode_of_payment: Funds disbursed to host institution for Fellow’s benefit
other_details.training: Research training and collaboration with Indian institutions
other_details.subsidy_details: All core costs including travel, insurance, and fellowship covered

category: Research, Fellowship, ASEAN, DST, Science and Technology, Innovation, International Collaboration

title: Promotion of Energy Audit and Conservation of Energy (PEACE): Incentive for Implementing Energy Audit Recommendations
description: The PEACE scheme by the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu, aims to support MSMEs in reducing energy consumption by providing financial incentives to implement Energy Audit Recommendations. The initiative helps optimize energy usage and lower electricity costs through support in acquiring new technology or modifying existing systems.
requirements: Copy of Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum / Udyam Certificate
Certificate of Registration (Partnership Act / LLP / Societies / Company Act)
Proof of connected load (EB Meter Card or Online Statement)
Proof of alternate energy source usage (if applicable)
Documents for engagement of Energy Auditor or Letter of Acceptance
Proof of employment or partnership of Energy Auditor (if applicable)
BEE Accreditation Certificate of Energy Auditor
Detailed Energy Audit Report (PDF format, max 200 KB)
eligibility: All manufacturing MSMEs in Tamil Nadu
Must have conducted a valid energy audit
Achieved at least 10% energy savings in energy consumption per unit of output over past 12-month average
Separate applications allowed for each unit of an enterprise
Minimum 3-year gap required between previous and current energy audit
exclusions: All Micro, Small, and Medium Service Enterprises
Manufacturing MSMEs that have availed similar subsidies from other Central/State schemes for the same purpose
financial_requirements: Subsidy applies only to post-audit investments
Must achieve minimum 10% energy savings to qualify
benefits: Subsidy of 50% of the eligible investment cost, up to ₹10,00,000
Applies separately to each audit (original and subsequent)
Subsidy disbursed after certified implementation of energy audit recommendations
If loan availed, subsidy can be adjusted directly into bank loan account
application_process: Step 1: Register on the MSME Department portal of Tamil Nadu
Step 2: Login with received credentials
Step 3: Navigate to 'Schemes' > Apply Online > New Application
Step 4: Fill application form, review and proceed
Step 5: Upload required documents in specified format
Step 6: Submit application and note reference number
Optional: Track application status via portal updates

other_details.duration: Subsidy applicable post-implementation of recommendations and certified audit report
other_details.mode_of_payment: Bank transfer or adjustment in loan account (if loan availed)
other_details.training: No specific training under this component
other_details.subsidy_details: 50% subsidy, capped at ₹10 lakhs; applied separately for original and subsequent audits
other_details.energy_saving_threshold: Minimum 10% reduction in specific energy consumption

category: Audit, Business, Energy, Enterprise, MSME, Sustainability, Tamil Nadu

title: Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme
description: A state-sponsored scholarship scheme launched by the Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab, in 1996. The scheme aims to support students with disabilities in pursuing academic, technical, or professional education by offering monthly scholarships.
requirements: Disability Certificate/UDID showing 40% and above disability
Income certificate showing annual income of parents less than ₹60,000
Copy of student’s bank account details
eligibility: Students residing in Punjab
Having 40% or more disability as per RPwD Act 2016
Family/guardian’s monthly income not exceeding ₹5,000
Student must have secured at least 40% marks in the previous annual exam
Applicable from Class 1 onwards
financial_requirements: Family income must be below ₹5,000 per month (₹60,000 annually)
benefits: ₹200 per month for students from Class 1 to 8
₹300 per month for students from Class 9 onwards
Scholarship is credited directly to the student’s bank account
application_process: Application must be submitted offline
Submit the filled application form to the head of the school/college/institution
The institution will verify and forward the application to the District Social Security Officer (DSSO)

other_details.mode_of_payment: Direct transfer to student’s bank account
other_details.disability_threshold: Minimum 40% disability as per RPwD Act 2016
other_details.academic_requirement: Minimum 40% marks in the previous annual examination

category: Disability, PwD, Scholarship, Student, Education, Punjab

title: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Marriage of Poor Brides Living Below Poverty Line
description: A scheme by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry, to provide financial assistance of ₹25,000 to poor brides living below the poverty line for meeting marriage expenses. The scheme is applicable only for the first marriage of the bride.
requirements: Submission at least 30 days before the proposed marriage date
eligibility: Annual family income not exceeding ₹75,000
Bride must be at least 18 years old; bridegroom must be at least 21 years old
Only for the first marriage of the bride
Marriage must be performed in accordance with the law
Assistance is applicable for the marriage of only one daughter per family
Parents/guardian must be Indian citizens and native to the UT of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence of 5 years or more
financial_requirements: Annual income of the family must be less than or equal to ₹75,000
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 for marriage expenses
application_process: Step 1: Visit the office/sub-office of the Department of Women and Child Development to obtain or print the application form
Step 2: Fill in all required details, attach passport photo and self-attested documents
Step 3: Submit the form to the Deputy Director (Women Development) or CDPO at least 30 days before the marriage
Step 4: Request an acknowledgment receipt with submission date and unique ID (if applicable)
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Bride, Father, and Mother
Birth Certificate or TC of Bride and Bridegroom
Certificate by MLA or Gazetted Officer
Marriage Invitation, Photo, and Registration Certificate
Voter ID of Bride, Father, and Mother
Xerox of bank passbook first page
Aadhaar Number or Aadhaar Enrolment ID with any supporting ID (PAN, Passport, Ration Card, Voter ID, MGNREGA, etc.)

other_details.mode_of_payment: Direct credit to applicant’s bank account
other_details.timing: Application must be submitted at least 30 days before marriage

category: Below Poverty Line, BPL, Bride, Financial Assistance, Marriage, Poor, Women, Puducherry
